seo_description: Disco-funk score for a graduation animation film. Original composer dropped out a week before deadline. I wrote everything from scratch in 8 days.
hero.title: Ray Animation
hero.subtitle: Music Composition / Disco-Funk Score / DAE Howest Graduation Film
about.text: A stone giant wakes up in a cave and discovers dance. That's the film. The original composer dropped out a week before the screening, so I got the call. Eight days to write a disco-funk score, do all the sound design, and deliver a final mix. I pulled the animatics into Pro Tools, hand-placed sync markers, and matched every musical hit to Ray's movements frame by frame. Three rounds of feedback with the animation team, each time adjusting timing and arrangement. Standing ovation at the cinema screening.
music.m1.title: Bass & Rhythm
music.m1.desc: Slap bass and electric drums. Chic, Earth Wind & Fire territory. Every rhythmic hit locked to Ray's dance moves, frame by frame.
music.m2.title: Brass, Sax & Synths
music.m2.desc: Brass carries the melody, saxophones fill out the warmth. DJ scratches between sections keep it moving. Mixed in Pro Tools, mastered with Waves J37 tape saturation for that analog warmth.
music.m3.title: Credits Version
music.m3.desc: Same theme, bigger arrangement. Gospel organs, live drums, Omnisphere synths layered on top. The team approved it on the first pass.
sync.s1.title: 8-Day Deadline
sync.s1.desc: The composer left a week before the screening. I took over everything: full score, sound design, final mix. No existing material to work from.
sync.s2.title: Frame-by-Frame Sync
sync.s2.desc: I placed markers by hand in Pro Tools to lock every musical hit to the animation. Tempo follows Ray, not the other way around.
sync.s3.title: Three Feedback Rounds
sync.s3.desc: Direct back-and-forth with the animation team. Timing, arrangement, and mix got tighter each round. Final version cleared for the cinema screening.
